title: Fine Tuning Pipeline
definition: The process of adapting a large language model (LLM) to a specific task or domain, consisting of dataset preparation, cloud GPU rental, LoRA training, GGUF export, and local deployment.

difficulty_levels.beginner: A method for teaching a computer model to understand a specific topic or subject, like a librarian organizing books in a library.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: A workflow for fine-tuning large language models to perform a specific task, leveraging LoRA training and the GGUF format for efficient deployment.
difficulty_levels.expert: A methodology for tailoring large language models to a specific domain or task, encompassing dataset preparation, cloud GPU rental, LoRA training, GGUF export, and local deployment, with a focus on efficiency and cost-effectiveness.

extra_fields.insight: The process of fine-tuning a large language model to adapt it to a specific task or domain, showcasing the power of AI customization.
